description: Provide `security-health validate scenario <name> --json` emitting the exact findings shape test-genie parses, exiting nonzero on any ERROR finding.

requirements.title: validate scenario --json output shape
requirements.description: The CLI command must emit JSON of the form {"findings":[{rule_id,severity,title,description,remediation,file_path}]} (plus a summary with error/warning/info counts) that maps cleanly onto the test-genie finding parser, exercised by a CLI↔proto parity binding.

validation.notes: validate scenario <name> --json against a known-clean scenario returns an empty findings array and exit code 0.
validate scenario <name> --json against a scenario with a planted secret returns at least one ERROR finding and exit code 1.
Each emitted finding carries non-empty rule_id, severity, title, and remediation fields.

requirements.title: ValidateScenario Connect RPC
requirements.description: The ValidationService.ValidateScenario Connect RPC must run the detector then the applicable scanners and return the aggregated normalized findings; the CLI is a thin translation layer over this RPC.

validation.notes: ValidateScenario over Connect returns the same findings the CLI renders for the same target.
